intent: Plan Phase 11 (kanban task -> CPM network -> earned value) on the board and write its design plus a Hermes-readable job brief.
summary: PSI-114: added Phase 11 to docs/list-task-project.md (PSI-114..PSI-123, backlog) after the operator asked to plan first; asked the operator the four C-15 questions and recorded the answers in the task accepts. Wrote docs/database-architecture/m12-task-lifecycle-cpm.md (M12: sub-tasks one level deep, delegation to one user or one board group, board_columns.kind todo/doing/done with is_done kept in sync, task_budgets table with its own RLS for planned/initial/final cash, task.budget key for admin/project-manager/operation, trigger-enforced start/finish gates, start_task/finish_task RPCs, finish auto-posts one outflow finance_entries row with source task_final; M13: PERT estimates in days, boards.project_start, task_links with advisory-lock cycle guard; full pgTAP list) and docs/frontend-architecture/features/cpm-evm.md (module layout, permission-to-UI table, drag-gate flow without optimistic move, pure engine API with typed errors, verified 38-week fixture, frappe-gantt wrapper rules, recharts EVM with standard PV/EV/AC definitions, one-query pipeline, e2e). Added docs/agent-operations/phase-11-brief.md as Hermes' job description (frozen decisions D1-D9, glossary, fixture, order and lanes, per-task traps) and repointed HANDOFF.md from the on-hold Phase 8 to Phase 11. Linked from system-overview.md, both layer READMEs, agent-operations README and kanban.md. Corrected two draft accepts: PSI-121 AC is initial cost replaced (not added) by final cash; PSI-123 drops the Docker URL bullet already fixed by PR #73. Remaining: operator review/merge; PSI-115 onward.

decisions.decision: Operator (C-15), AskUserQuestion answer: "Standard EVM (Recommended)" - EV = planned cash x completion (0/50/100 by column kind); CPI and SPI shown.
decisions.reason: Keeps PV, EV and AC comparable.

decisions.decision: Operator (C-15): "New task.budget key (Recommended)" granted to admin, project-manager and operation, scoped to tasks the caller authored or is delegated.
decisions.reason: Operation delegates must enter costs without finance.* and without breaking PSI-104's no-amounts rule.

decisions.decision: Operator (C-15): "Yes, auto-post (Recommended)" - finishing a task upserts one outflow finance_entries row (source task_final); reopening deletes it.
alternatives: Keep task cash separate from the ledger

decisions.reason: Only one new dependency; recharts custom dots give point styling.

decisions.decision: Task cash lives in a separate task_budgets table with its own RLS, not in columns on tasks.
decisions.reason: RLS is row-level and every board member reads tasks, so amounts on that row would leak.

decisions.decision: AC = initial cost from start, replaced (not added) by final cash at finish.
decisions.reason: Adding both double counts the same spend; corrected in PSI-121's draft accept.

decisions.decision: Gates key on a new board_columns.kind and are enforced by DB triggers; new tasks must be created in a todo column.
decisions.reason: Column titles are free text; a budget row cannot exist before its task.
